\parbox{0.97\linewidth}{\footnotesize OLS on the 1:1 matched sample of announcements on mega-cap reaction days (MegaDay $=1$) and matched controls. CARs, SUE and past return are in percent; SUE is earnings surprise scaled by price. Controls: log market cap, book-to-market (set to 0 with a dummy for negative book equity), log(1 + analysts), past return, the same-day announcement count (hundreds) and its interaction with SUE. Small firms and low coverage are the halves at or below the within-quarter median of market cap and analyst count. $t$-statistics in parentheses use standard errors clustered by reaction day; $^{*}$, $^{**}$, $^{***}$: 10\%, 5\%, 1\%. Fama-MacBeth averages quarterly estimates (without quarter effects); $t$ from their time-series standard error. Crowding out predicts $\beta_3<0$ for CAR$(0,+1)$ and $\beta_3>0$ for CAR$(+2,+60)$.}
